name: Algolia Productivity
description: Connect LLM tools to your Algolia account with user-scoped access for internal workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Algolia Productivity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Algolia Productivity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.algolia.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Algolia Productivity MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Algolia Productivity lists 16 MCP tools, including algolia_analytics_click_positions, algolia_analytics_no_click_rate, algolia_analytics_no_results_rate, algolia_analytics_number_of_searches, algolia_analytics_number_of_users, algolia_analytics_searches_no_results, algolia_analytics_top_countries, algolia_analytics_top_filters, algolia_analytics_top_filters_no_results, algolia_analytics_top_search_results, algolia_analytics_top_searches, and algolia_analytics_top_searches_without_clicks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Algolia Productivity?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Algolia Productivity in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Algolia Productivity MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Algolia Productivity requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Algolia Productivity is developed by Algolia. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
